_comment: The products that publish a changelog, and the tag prefix each one releases under.
This is the registry every consumer reads: hub/scripts/sync-changelog.mjs uses it to
walk changelog/<id>/, scripts/check-changelog.mjs uses it to turn a pushed tag into
the entry file that tag must have, and the hub renders `name` and `blurb` on the
changelog index. Adding a product means adding it here and creating its directory —

products.name: MJOLNIR Launcher
products.blurb: Installs the runtime, manages your mods, and launches Halo Campaign Evolved.

products.name: MJOLNIR Tag Editor
products.blurb: Browse and edit the Blam tags, textures, audio and scripts inside your installed game.

products.name: MJOLNIR Runtime
products.blurb: The signed UE4SS bundle every mod runs on, with the signatures and config this game needs.

products.name: MJOLNIR CLI
products.blurb: The `mjolnir` command line: list, inspect, edit and repack the tags in your installed game.

products.name: MJOLNIR Code Mods
products.blurb: The first-party script mods, built in CI and covered by one Ed25519 signature.
